sourceFindings.assessment: The actual route checks completed status and parses MAIN JSON, then collects candidates before recoverPrecisionGeometry or calibration. A local const carries primitive copied candidate data through merging. The final assignment after context calibration overrides any identically named report field and does not attach candidates to context. Provider envelopes, models, output caps, dispatch count and rescue predicate are unchanged by this integration.

The existing owning hook creates a fresh Image for the captured image string and reads that exact raster. Recovery runs only with a valid nonempty MAIN candidate envelope, distinct numeric corroborations and confirmed identity. The new-only path applies the four-million-pixel bound before canvas allocation. The established path retains its prior size policy; detector still enforces the new bound before its own allocation.

Source inspection confirms the useMemo binding still includes image, report, identityConfirmed, enabled and confirmation. Returned result must have identical binding in the current render; new A-B-A and revoked-reconfirmed transitions cannot reuse the previous binding. Effect cleanup aborts, removes handlers, and publish checks the controller. Parent passes shared measurement including explicit null to mounted source/pattern/liquidity components, disabling their local readers. Actual new-path browser lifecycle execution remains pending.

Recovery is attempted when the old path produces no drawable levels. Successful legacy placement retains priority. Current image string, report object, identity, measured dimensions, region and OCR evidence must agree before recovery projection. The original overlay uses the returned projected y in original image pixels; main map, status, story and provenance consume the same placed list. Context is held and raw context levels are not merged into it.

Independent image axis is retained only in imageRecovery. The hook leaves legacy axis held and legacy pixels null when the legacy path is ineligible. OriginalChartEvidence still supplies only legacy axis/pixels to unchanged pattern and liquidity selectors. No new recovery code upgrades report quality, bounds, levels, liquidity or pattern evidence.

Only IMAGE_AXIS placement receives POSITION_CHECKED, AI_CANDIDATE, LOW and explicit unconfirmed support/resistance wording. Bare UNVERIFIED remains APPROXIMATE with explicitly unchecked position, overriding hostile USER VERIFIED labels and arbitrary anchor count.
